Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!
Zoe always gets groomed at Petco and they always do a good job

We had a wonderful experience at the Petco in Ahwatukee! Naomi took excellent care of our Daisy’s and did an amazing job. She was friendly, professional, and made us feel welcome from the moment we arrived. Daisy’s came back looking great, smelling fresh, and seemed happy and comfortable. I truly appreciate the care and attention she gave. I highly recommend this Petco grooming salon to anyone looking for quality grooming services!

We are very happy with Naomi, Teddy’s new groomer. She is so patient and caring. Teddy is always nervous and having a new groomer is always nerve wracking for us, but Naomi made us feel at ease. We are sad Marisa is gone, but now we have Naomi and we hope she won’t leave. Petco please do what you need to retain good groomers!! (The 3rd picture is from yesterday. The first two pictures were from last year’s review, it won’t let me delete them.)

(Review in 2025)  Our pet stylist is Marisa and she does a wonderful job grooming our Teddy. She’s always so friendly, gentle, and patient!  We love how handsome our Teddy is after his grooming yesterday!
Naomi does an excellent job. My dog Hershey absolutely loves seeing her every visit for his nail trims!

I'm super sad Marissa left. She was the only reason I went to Petco Grooming in Ahwatukee. This last time I took my doodle in, they simply shaved her. Marissa always made an effort to make my dog look so beautiful with a stylish cut, and now they just shave her. Nothing against the current "stylists," but Marissa was a rare talent and she always exceeded my expectations. We miss her tremendously. Any prior clients of hers have her cell number? I lost her number and wish I could contact her....
I was disappointed this time. My dog didn’t smell clean and her nails were not trimmed very well either. Been going here for a while but probably not anymore.
Naomi is a fantastic groomer,  took great care of my boy and always does a great job 👍🏼
They always do a good job!

After 11 years of being a loyal customer, Petco refused to groom my dog because of his age. They fired their best groomer, Marisa. I will never be taking any of my pets to this Petco going forward. I will be looking for Marisa online since she was always the best. This Petco has a staffing problem, very unprofessional. How disappointing!

The cost increases every time I take my dog in for a grooming. Employees go & come to often, which indicates to me they are unhappy.  The additional "material fee" charge is outrageous. Oddly when i dropped my dog off no other customers or dogs in sight same thing when I picked up my dog. The fill in manager was rude & a little to bossy for me. I felt very uncomfortable on my last visit to petco & will be looking for a new dog groomer after 8 or more years. So sorry Petco, this store has a employee problem.

Groomers quit. No phone call to cancel. I arranged my day around a grooming appointment and not even a courtesy call to cancel, just a sign on the door saying no groomers available. As a matter of fact, I got an appointment reminder text that morning. (2/22) Yet they require substantial notice if you need to cancel appointment.  I found this to be incredibly unprofessional to do to a client. I left my phone number and asked for a manager to call me…..which never happened.
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!
Marissa, in grooming is attentive, hard working and attentive. She goes above and beyond.

refused vaccinations ? my cousin is going through a tough time and had to find homes for his new kittens. knowing she hasn't been vaccinated, I scheduled to get her shots the same day he was dropping her off, as he is tight on money. I picked one of the later times, 5:10p.

when we got there the vet said I need to have her in my care for a week before they can vaccinate .... why does the VETCO website say the opposite? "If your pet's vaccination history is unknown, we must assume the pet has not been vaccinated and our veterinarians may recommend completing the series to ensure your pet is fully protected" even though I know she isn't vaccinated, the website also says "What happens if I missed my puppy or kitten's booster vaccines? - Vaccinate as soon as possible if your pet misses a vaccination." (see FAQ's on Vetco's website to find these).

I've already got a cat at home, and they want me to keep them separated for a week ? I have to keep one in a room at all times?

lazy doctors are not real doctors. Whoever is the "vet" here has no motivation and clearly wanted to leave early. I tried to call back just to ask some questions to understand better- I’m no vet! - but the vet left.
Before the vet hours were said to close.

Told me all I needed to know!

My dog was done at 11:30. I picked him up at 14:30. I got a warning that I might not able to return after 3 warnings. New management policy which I was not informed at check in allows 4 hours. It was 3 hours. May consider other place.
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!
Marissa is always so sweet to my Sunni
Marissa is always very efficient and courteous.

Very clean store very friendly and family oriented. All the employees are are very helpful and nice. I’ve always always have a good experience every time I go in Jane my groomer who does the grooming services at that location. She is beyond awesome always book with her.
Marissa is not only The most Amazing Groomer I have ever had and my Puppy Bruin loves her as well I do!! She’s so kind, caring, and takes great exceptional care of him!! Thank You Marissa!!
We have had the same wonderful groomer named Marisa and she is exceptional. She is wonderful with our two overexcited miniature schnauzers. Our dogs always look amazing.
Marissa is 10/10!  I won't take my dogs anywhere else.
MARISSA DID A GREAT JOB
Finn is treated well, and always comes home looking great.

5ook my dog to awayukee location. Hair cut with Jane.  2nd day of grooming  I could already grungy smell from my dog. Most of all they cut the skin while they trim butt area.
My dog is irritating from small cut and bleeding.
She charged extra money for ehave  brush out and sissoring...
Which i dont understand. They already charged $85.00 for grooming.
Grooming doesn't include sissoring and brush out???
This is the first time they add to my bill.
I have been going there more than 3 years but will not go back to her again.

I was pretty satisfied previous grooming service this location but they charged extra $10 for shave, brushout, and sissoring this time. I guess that Bath with haircut basic service should include those things. They are all about the haircut but they charged extra. Please be aware you will get charged extra $10 without any notice when you check out!!!!
I was very pleased at how well Buddy looked and felt after his appointment. We will definitely be back

We appreciate your honest rating and feedback, Debra Anderson, even though it was a low-star review. We're sorry to hear that your experience wasn't as satisfactory as we would have hoped. Your input is important to us!

Our experience was wonderful. Our senior dog gets the VIP treatment every time we bring him in for grooming due to he being extremely temperamental. We always request for Marissa. She was able to get us in bright and early, went straight to work on our boy, and was quick to get him back to us clean cut and styling the cutest bandana!
Marissa is the only groomer who our boy allows to work on him!
She is excellent!!!
Marissa is very polite and accommodating. she makes me feel safe to leave our dogs with her.
Excellent service and they got me in the same day
Highly recommended!
Hi. Summer Peterkin. We appreciate your excellent review! Thank you, and we hope to see you again soon!
The groomers here are excellent! They know my dog and make sure he feels safe and comfortable.  I think he's actually starting to look forward to seeing them every month!
Hair cut was good but average.  Price is terribly high.  $80 for a small dog shampoo and curt is excessive.  Will have to consider somewhere else for this service.
